_comment: PGZ-95: four QW-2 infrared MANPADS missiles on the turret, CLC-1 search radar. War Thunder has no PGZ-95; the numbers follow its PGZ04A (the same turret and four-missile layout): HN-6 optical IR seeker, warm-up 2 s (40 ticks), lock cone 15 degrees, rangeMax 5,000 m, fire-and-forget; radar CLC-1 range 10 km. Passive IR: the seeker must hold the target before launch, so a shot without a lock is refused. The pack's range figure is metres / 10 (the Vodnik's 9M336 is 500 for 5 km).
